Theo / team — brief technical update from triage:
- Root cause (probable): increased KV cache eviction observed on a subset of GPU hosts leading to repeated KV reconstructs and backend 5xx errors. Memory growth appears correlated with a model variant deployed last week.
- Mitigation applied (15:55 PDT): enabled fallback routing to variant-v2-lite for 85% of traffic and increased Dedicated pool by 3 nodes. TTL for fallback set to 2 hours while we stabilize.
- Observed effect: error rate dropped from 12% -> 3.5%, p95 improved from 1.8s -> ~620ms. Some tail requests still show elevated latency; we are collecting request traces.

Next steps:
1) Hold fallback for now while we patch the variant memory handling in a test env.
2) If stable over next 90 minutes, gradually shift 95% traffic to fallback and start a controlled canary for the patched variant.
3) Post-incident: we will run a root-cause writeup and model-level memory regression test.

Will post a 30-minute update.

—Neha Kapoor
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference
